qa.title: Q439 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If there are 2 Fable counters on this follower when it attacks, can I remove both of them and play its Strike ability twice?

qa.title: Q438 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If my deck becomes empty after playing this follower's Strike ability, do I lose the game?
qa.answer: No. You don't lose the game until you have to draw a card from your empty deck.

qa.title: Q456 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: What does "Add 1 to a Stack on your field" mean?
qa.answer: It means you put a Stack counter on an amulet with Stack on your field.

qa.title: Q455 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I activate this follower's ability once during my turn, can I activate it once more during my opponent's turn?

qa.title: Q454 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I play this follower's activated ability, then banish 10 spells in my cemetery to play Dimension Shift for 7 play points, does it instead cost 3 to play?

qa.title: Q453 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I play this follower's activated ability, then play a spell for 0 play points with Merlin's On Evolve ability, does the next spell I play cost 4 less?
qa.answer: No. The effect of this follower's activated ability applies to the spell you play with Merlin's On Evolve ability.

qa.title: Q466 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I put an evolved follower into the cemetery to pay for this follower's Fanfare ability, do I refer to the cost of its unevolved form?
qa.answer: Yes. The cost of an evolved follower is always the same as the cost of its unevolved form.

qa.title: Q465 (Jan. 31, 2024)
qa.question: If I reveal all the cards in my deck and none of them cost more than the follower I put into the cemetery, what happens?
qa.answer: You simply shuffle all the cards you revealed and put them back in your deck area.
